payload.description_html: Tomistoma skull fossil, at the National Museum of Natural History, Vilhena Palace, Republic of Malta. The genus Tomistoma, which is found fossilized in the Tertiary rocks of several parts of Europe, is now confined to the seas around Borneo and is represented by one single species, Tomistoma schlegelii.
